gaps.sentence: The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).

gaps.sentence: The security guard waved us ___ without checking our passes.
gaps.explanation: 'Wave somebody through' = signal them to pass a checkpoint.

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.

gaps.sentence: He ___ up the word in an online dictionary.
gaps.explanation: 'Look a word up' = check its meaning.
bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
